Source: https://codeload.github.com/knik0/faad2/zip/refs/tags/2.11.4
Archive SHA-256: f4d3630ffdbf17ef17e358007c91d6b51e487de0771dd2d3b3e994d4f0ad81ff
Tag: 2.11.4
Scope: decoder C sources and headers, downloaded during CMake configuration.
The Git repository retains COPYING, AUTHORS and this origin/modification record.
cmake/faad2.cmake verifies the archive SHA-256 and adapts a build-local copy.
Release source archives include the upstream decoder sources under source/.
License: GPL-2.0-or-later; see COPYING and the original per-file notices.
Code from FAAD2 is copyright (c) Nero AG, www.nero.com
Local modifications (TTPlayer Rebuild, 2026-09-22):
- include/neaacdec.h: FAAD_STATIC disables dllexport for static embedding in ttp_aac.
  It does not change the calling convention or public decoder data structures.
- libfaad/common.h: rename the MSVC inline lrintf helper to faad_lrintf to avoid a
  collision with the modern compiler's intrinsic. Keep the original x87 body.
  Include CRT math declarations before the alias so XP UCRT prototypes are
  not renamed to the private helper.
Build: x86, floating-point output, APPLY_DRC=1, /O1 /Ob2 /Os /GL,
       /fp:precise /arch:SSE2, VC-LTL 5.3.1 and YY-Thunks 1.2.2.
The wrapper derives original NeAACDecInit2's additional frame-length result
from AudioSpecificConfig, without changing the public upstream decoder ABI.
PCM validation uses the 2.11.4 baseline; it is not bit-identical to FAAD2 2.7.

Local compatibility fixes (TTPlayer Rebuild, 2026-10-29):
cmake/faad2_compat.cmake applies checked replacements to the copied build sources;
the pinned upstream archive and shared download cache are never changed.
- libfaad/syntax.c: limit the two ID_FIL/SBR look-aheads to ordinary, non-ER
  raw_data_block syntax. ER AAC's fixed channel-element sequence must not parse
  access-unit tail bits as an ordinary fill_element. This fixes AAC LD reporting
  bytesconsumed beyond the packet boundary; the wrapper's bounds check remains.
- libfaad/common.c, common.h and tns.c: use the LD TNS bandwidth limits from
  ISO/IEC 14496-3:2009 section 4.6.17.2.5, tables 4.172/4.173, including the
  different 480/512-sample limits. Pass frame length through the private helper.
  The public FAAD ABI is unchanged. The FATE er_ad6000np_44.s16 regression file
  and independent FFmpeg decoding corroborate the corrected LD output; the
  previous LC/Main/HE/LTP regression PCM remains the reference for those modes.
- libfaad/mp4.c: retain explicit 24-bit ASC frequencies and normalize them only
  when exactly equal to an existing supported frequency-table entry. SBR output
  also retains exact doubles of supported core rates (for example 192 kHz from
  a 96 kHz core), including the sync-extension form. Reject
  missing SBR presence/rate bits rather than interpreting zero-filled bits as
  a complete configuration. Unsupported arbitrary rates are not rounded.
The LD correction intentionally changes output from the original FAAD2 2.7
implementation; it is a format-correctness fix, not a bit-exact old-decoder mode.
